external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store who signs in through their own identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us

external_entities.name: own device at home
external_entities.description: A colleague's own device used to sign in from home.
external_entities.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system that supplies group membership changes and leaver status overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: it comes from the HR system overnight

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: A franchise's identity provider that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: franchise store
external_entities.description: A franchise store whose colleagues are admitted through the identity broker.
external_entities.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, manages directory membership, validates federated sign-ins, and writes sign-in audit events.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses token groups to authorize price changes and transaction voids for every store.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory of colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what that log records, whether it covers the franchise route, or whether the directory or the log are encrypted where they sit.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in through the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are

data_flows.name: franchise sign-in
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague is signed in through the broker using a federated identity.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in

data_flows.name: vouch sign-in
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague to the broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
data_flows.notes: We have not written down which colleagues that provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token containing a staff ID and group membership to the store admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.data_description: Token containing staff ID and groups

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the broker's signing key.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: Public half of the token-signing key

data_flows.name: update membership
data_flows.description: The HR system supplies colleague and group membership changes to the directory overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.data_description: Colleagues, group memberships, and leaver changes

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The broker pulls HR changes once a night.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night

data_flows.name: keep signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker keeps its signing key in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.

data_flows.name: change prices
data_flows.description: A colleague with the store-manager group uses the console to change prices.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices

data_flows.name: void transactions
data_flows.description: A colleague with the store-manager group uses the console to void transactions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network on which the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: home devices
trust_boundaries.description: The tenant-controlled environment of colleagues' own devices at home.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise-controlled environment associated with the franchise identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

assumptions.assumption: The directory contains confidential information because it stores colleagues and their group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory keeps colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The key store contains confidential information because it stores the token-signing key.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the broker keeps a signing key in the key store.
